purpose: Verify authenticated users can browse all published catalogue entries
preconditions: Published catalogue entries exist in the system
expected_result: All published catalogue entries are returned and draft/retired are excluded

purpose: Verify catalogue entry displays description, eligibility criteria, required documents, dates, and renewal information
preconditions: A published scholarship catalogue entry exists with full criteria
expected_result: Description, min_cpi, max_family_income, required_documents, window dates, and renewal_allowed are present

purpose: Verify SPACS Convener can create a new draft catalogue entry
action_or_input: Create new catalogue entry with scheme code, name, and scholarship type
expected_result: Catalogue entry is created with status Draft and version 1

purpose: Verify modifying a published catalogue entry increments version and preserves historical version
preconditions: A published catalogue entry with version 1 exists
expected_result: Catalogue entry version is incremented and historical version record is preserved

purpose: Verify catalogue version can be published only when policy approval ref and effective dates are recorded
action_or_input: Publish with policy approval reference and effective dates
expected_result: Status changes to Published and immutable version snapshot is stored

purpose: Verify publishing fails if policy approval reference is missing
action_or_input: Publish with empty policy approval reference
expected_result: AwardPolicyError raised; publication prohibited

purpose: Verify SPACS Convener can retire a catalogue entry prospectively
expected_result: Status changes to Retired while existing applications remain intact

purpose: Verify system preserves auditable version history of catalogue criteria and effective periods
preconditions: A catalogue entry has been published across multiple versions
expected_result: All versions, their criteria snapshots, policy refs, and effective periods are retained

purpose: Verify student can start an application only for a published scheme within open window
preconditions: A published scheme exists with an open application window
expected_result: Draft application is created successfully

purpose: Verify student cannot start an application if the application window is closed
preconditions: A published scheme exists whose window has closed
expected_result: EligibilityError raised stating window is closed

purpose: Verify system evaluates machine-checkable eligibility at submission and blocks unqualified applicants
preconditions: A draft application exists for a scheme requiring CPI >= 7.5
expected_result: EligibilityError raised; submission rejected

purpose: Verify system prevents duplicate active applications for same student, scholarship and cycle
preconditions: Student already has a submitted application for scheme X in cycle 2026-27
action_or_input: Student initiates a second application for scheme X in cycle 2026-27
expected_result: DuplicateApplicationError raised

purpose: Verify student can enter and update application data
expected_result: Application data is updated successfully

purpose: Verify student can upload supporting documents
expected_result: Document record created and linked to application

purpose: Verify system permits reuse of prior valid uploaded documents
preconditions: Student has prior valid document with future expiry
expected_result: Document reused successfully for the new application

purpose: Verify explicit draft saving preserves input without requiring mandatory validation
preconditions: Draft application exists with partial inputs
action_or_input: Save draft updates with incomplete fields
expected_result: Draft is saved without completeness error

purpose: Verify submission validates all mandatory fields and required documents are present
preconditions: Draft application is missing required income certificate
expected_result: CompletenessError raised; submission rejected

purpose: Verify submission assigns unique ID, records timestamp and binds to catalogue version
preconditions: Complete draft application meets eligibility criteria
expected_result: Application has unique ID, submitted_at timestamp, and catalogue_version bound

purpose: Verify submission transitions state to Submitted and creates verification task for assistant
expected_result: State is submitted and SpacsTask created for role spacs_assistant

purpose: Verify submission emits notifications to student and assistant
expected_result: Notification with event_type submitted exists for student

purpose: Verify authorized SPACS Assistant can open assigned application for verification
expected_result: State transitions to under_verification

purpose: Verify assistant records findings without possessing final sanction authority
action_or_input: Assistant records verification findings and attempts approve
expected_result: Findings saved; assistant cannot approve directly (UnauthorizedActionError)

purpose: Verify assistant can return application to student for correction with recorded reason
expected_result: State transitions to correction_required and correction_reason is recorded

purpose: Verify student can modify an application in Correction Required state
expected_result: Application data updated successfully

purpose: Verify resubmission revalidates application and invalidates prior verification findings
expected_result: State transitions to resubmitted and prior verification findings/authenticity cleared

purpose: Verify assistant can mark verified and route to Convener for decision
expected_result: State transitions to verified and decision task routed to spacs_convener

purpose: Verify assistant can record unresolved verification concern and route to Convener
preconditions: Application is under verification with potential concern
expected_result: State transitions to verification_concern and task routed to convener

purpose: Verify system issues reminders and escalations when tasks exceed configured SLA threshold
preconditions: A pending verification task was created > 48 hours ago
expected_result: Task is flagged and escalated notification is generated

purpose: Verify authorized Convener can review applications routed for decision
expected_result: State transitions to under_convener_review

purpose: Verify Convener can approve, reject, or return application for correction
expected_result: Decision is executed and state updated to approved

purpose: Verify system records decision outcome, decision actor, timestamp and reason
action_or_input: Inspect decision record fields on application
expected_result: decision_actor_user_id, decision_at, and decision_reason are populated

purpose: Verify system updates state and notifies student of decision outcome
expected_result: Decision notification exists with event_type approved or rejected

purpose: Verify student can modify application only while in editable states
action_or_input: Student attempts to modify application data while submitted
expected_result: UnauthorizedActionError raised; modification rejected

purpose: Verify permitted modification in correction_required revalidates and resets verification
preconditions: Application in correction_required modified by student
expected_result: Application revalidated and routed back to verification queue

purpose: Verify student can withdraw application only while in withdrawable state before final decision
action_or_input: Student attempts to withdraw approved application
expected_result: UnauthorizedActionError raised; withdrawal rejected after final decision

purpose: Verify on withdrawal state is Withdrawn, pending tasks are closed, audit logged and student notified
preconditions: Application is in submitted state with pending assistant task
expected_result: State is withdrawn, pending tasks marked completed, audit log and notification created

purpose: Verify student can view own application status history
expected_result: Returns only applications belonging to the student

purpose: Verify download/export restricted to owner or authorized staff
action_or_input: Student B attempts to export application of student A
expected_result: UnauthorizedActionError raised

purpose: Verify system identifies awarded scholarship as renewal-eligible only when scheme permits and window is open
expected_result: RenewalEligibilityError raised

purpose: Verify renewal application prefills reusable prior data while linking to parent application
preconditions: Student has an approved application for a renewal-eligible scheme
expected_result: Renewal application created with is_renewal=True, parent_application linked, and data prefilled

purpose: Verify renewal validates updated eligibility and refreshed evidence
preconditions: Student submits renewal with current CPI below required threshold
expected_result: EligibilityError raised; renewal rejected

purpose: Verify submitted renewal routes through verification and fresh convener decision
expected_result: State is renewal_submitted; task created for assistant; not auto-approved

purpose: Verify system sends renewal reminders to eligible students before deadline
preconditions: Students with approved scholarships exist for a renewal-eligible scheme
expected_result: Renewal reminder notifications created for eligible students

purpose: Verify system supports configured candidate-source methods for awards
preconditions: Award scheme configured with candidate_source_method system_pool
expected_result: Award cycle created in state open with criteria version bound

purpose: Verify Convener can prepare and finalize candidate pool for award cycle
action_or_input: Convener prepares candidate pool with candidate records
expected_result: Candidate records created and cycle state transitions to pool_prepared

purpose: Verify Award Evaluation Committee can record shortlist, scores and recommendations
action_or_input: Committee begins evaluation and records scores/recommendation
expected_result: Candidate evaluation scores saved and state transitions to committee_result_recorded

purpose: Verify Convener records final award approval reference
action_or_input: Convener records approved outcome with Senate reference
expected_result: State transitions to ready_for_publication and approval evidence saved

purpose: Verify award results can be published only after final approval outcome is recorded
preconditions: Award cycle is in committee_result_recorded state without approval
expected_result: AwardPolicyError raised; publication prohibited until approval recorded

purpose: Verify award publication preserves candidates, evaluations, recommendations and approval references
preconditions: Award cycle is in ready_for_publication state
expected_result: State transitions to published, published_at is set, and winner notified

purpose: Verify system creates notifications for significant lifecycle events
expected_result: Notifications created and persisted in SpacsNotification table

purpose: Verify system creates time-stamped audit records for significant actions
expected_result: Timestamp, event_type, entity_id, and actor_user_id recorded accurately

purpose: Verify audit records are immutable and protected from alteration or deletion
action_or_input: Attempt delete or modify audit log
expected_result: AuditProtectionError raised; modification blocked

purpose: Verify system enforces role- and ownership-based access control across all operations
preconditions: Student attempts to perform staff verification or convener approval
action_or_input: Call verification or decision service with student role
expected_result: UnauthorizedActionError raised

purpose: Verify role reassignment routes pending tasks to new holder while preserving history of completed actions
preconditions: Pending verification tasks assigned to assistant A
action_or_input: Reassign role tasks to assistant B
expected_result: Pending tasks updated to assistant B; historical audit records preserve assistant A
